description: Bound all three generate_stock retry cycles to 32 random attempts. After the cap use permitted age 2, a deterministic valid same-category pool candidate (recent duplicates only relaxed), or core attributes at least 2. Abort to home/city when the category has no valid registered candidate.

edits.old:
!RANDOM AGE
		:loop_meta
			meta_type = rand(1,5)
			if meta_type = 4: meta_type = 2
			if meta_type = 5: meta_type = 3
edits.new:
!RANDOM AGE
		! JO9 MOD START GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_META
		local jo9_gen_meta_tries = 0
		:loop_meta
		if jo9_gen_meta_tries < 32:
			jo9_gen_meta_tries += 1
			meta_type = rand(1,5)
			if meta_type = 4: meta_type = 2
			if meta_type = 5: meta_type = 3
		else
			meta_type = 2
		end
		! JO9 MOD END GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_META

! JO9 MOD START GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_TYPE
	local jo9_gen_type_tries = 0
	:loop_type
	jo9_gen_type_tries += 1
	if jo9_gen_type_tries > 32:
		! Same installed pool as jo9_mob_pool; only recent-type exclusion is relaxed.
		local jo9_gen_pool_count = 0
		if meta_type = 1: jo9_gen_pool_count = max(0, loli_last-loli_first+1) + 180
		if meta_type = 2: jo9_gen_pool_count = max(0, max(young_last,1462)-young_first+1) + 260
		if meta_type = 3: jo9_gen_pool_count = max(0, max(milf_last,2340)-milf_first+1) + 288
		local jo9_gen_scan = 1
		local jo9_gen_age = iif(meta_type=1, CONST_INT['loli_age'], iif(meta_type=2, CONST_INT['young_age'], CONST_INT['milf_age']))
		:jo9_gen_type_fallback
		if jo9_gen_scan <= jo9_gen_pool_count:
			stock_type = func('jo9_mob_pool', meta_type, jo9_gen_scan)
			if stock_type > 0 and stock_type ! 1448 and stock_type ! 1450 and stock_type ! 2339:
				if $seed_ava[stock_type] ! '' and seed_age[stock_type] = jo9_gen_age:
					if (no_loli ! 1 or meta_type ! 1) and (no_milf ! 1 or meta_type ! 3): jump 'jo9_gen_type_ready'
				end
			end
			jo9_gen_scan += 1
			jump 'jo9_gen_type_fallback'
		end
		! No valid installed candidate: abort the caller instead of accepting type zero.
		dynamic $clear_slave_instance, 'stock'
		stock_state = CONST_INT['no_slave']
		stock_type = 0
		slave_base_price = 0
		msg '대상을 불러오지 못했습니다. 이전 화면으로 돌아갑니다.'
		if is_home = 1: gt 'main_screen'
		gt 'city_menu_form'
	end
	! JO9 MOD END GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_TYPE

edits.old: prev_num_type[num_count] = stock_type &! record that we have used this type
edits.new:
! JO9 MOD START GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_TYPE_READY
	:jo9_gen_type_ready
	if jo9_gen_type_tries > 32 and num_count >= 88:
		killvar 'num_count'
		killvar 'prev_num_type'
		num_count = 0
		prev_num_type = 0
	end
	! JO9 MOD END GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_TYPE_READY
	prev_num_type[num_count] = stock_type &! record that we have used this type

edits.old:
i = 0
!Slaves can now no longer generate with stats less than one.
edits.new:
i = 0
! JO9 MOD START GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_ATTR_INIT
local jo9_gen_attr_tries = 0
! JO9 MOD END GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_ATTR_INIT
!Slaves can now no longer generate with stats less than one.

! JO9 MOD START GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_ATTR
jo9_gen_attr_tries += 1
if attribute_sum < 12:
	if jo9_gen_attr_tries < 32:
		i = 0
		jump 'loop'
	end
	! Keep the sum threshold; raise low core attributes without reducing preset values.
	stock['stamina'] = max(2, stock['stamina'])
	stock['beauty'] = max(2, stock['beauty'])
	stock['sensitivity'] = max(2, stock['sensitivity'])
	stock['intellect'] = max(2, stock['intellect'])
	stock['temper'] = max(2, stock['temper'])
	stock['ego'] = max(2, stock['ego'])
	attribute_sum = stock['stamina'] + stock['beauty'] + stock['sensitivity'] + stock['intellect'] + stock['temper'] + stock['ego']
end
! JO9 MOD END GENERATOR_RETRY_BOUNDS_20261116_ATTR
